title: Turnover Analysis Dashboard
summary: Executive HR turnover dashboard built in Excel to transform raw exit interview data into actionable insights about resignation drivers, employee grades, department impact, and talent retention trends.
impact: Transformed raw HR exit interview exports into a structured and analysis-ready dataset.
Normalized multi-select resignation reasons to enable accurate turnover driver analysis.
Built executive KPI cards for turnover volume, top talent loss, average tenure, and most impacted departments.
Created professional HR dashboards with monthly resignation trends, grade distribution analysis, and resignation reason breakdowns.
Reduced manual HR analysis effort by centralizing turnover reporting into a presentation-ready Excel dashboard.
businessValue: Helped HR teams quickly identify major resignation drivers.
Improved visibility into critical talent losses and department-level turnover concentration.
Supported management reporting with executive-ready visuals and KPIs.
Enabled faster and more accurate turnover discussions using structured analytics.
